# BMCircuits

Sydney-based electronic design house.

## Services
- PCB and hardware design (schematic capture, multi-layer layout, impedance control, DFM)
- Embedded systems design (STM32, Raspberry Pi, RTOS, BSP development)
- Firmware development (C/C++, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, OTA updates)
- CAD enclosure and sheet metal design (SolidWorks, injection moulding, CNC)
- Production test fixture development (bed-of-nails, functional test rigs)

## Industries served
Medical devices, automotive, fire industry, consumer electronics, agriculture

## Location
Sydney, New South Wales, Australia — available globally
